stories.title: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
stories.take: Apple's fall Mac refresh leads with the M6 Pro — the machine to watch for creative pros weighing an upgrade.

stories.title: Some iPhone Duo screens are already failing, Apple says only a "small number" are affected
stories.take: Early Duo failures in the same spot are the first real stress test for Apple's $2,000 two-screen bet.

stories.title: Why Anthropic's IPO Prospectus Is Missing So Many Key Figures
stories.take: Anthropic filed to go public but left out customer and cost detail investors normally get — read the gaps, not just the growth.

stories.title: Microsoft offers to buy out a quarter of its workforce
stories.take: Voluntary exits for about 60,000 people is Microsoft's biggest workforce reset yet in the AI era.

stories.title: Cohere says Alibaba's Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
stories.take: A serious claim about a rival model exfiltrating a file — if verified, it changes how enterprises vet open models.

stories.title: How solid-state transformers could help power the AI boom
stories.take: The grid bottleneck for data centers may be solved in the transformer, not the chip.

stories.title: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
stories.take: Vehicle-to-home power at the lowest US price yet makes the Fathom a backup-power play as much as a truck.

stories.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
stories.take: Local, in-browser AI is Opera's pitch for privacy — and a shot at how Chrome and Safari ship assistants.

stories.title: Jay-Z Will Finally Headline Super Bowl 61 Halftime Show After Years Behind the Scenes
stories.take: After years picking the halftime act, Jay-Z takes the stage himself — the Super Bowl's biggest brand moment gets its curator as headliner.

stories.title: Anthropic's ad bill is soaring, according to IPO filing
stories.take: The IPO filing shows Anthropic is now spending like a consumer brand to win enterprise mindshare.

stories.title: Salesforce's $5.7 billion Braze deal puts marketers at an ecosystem crossroads
stories.take: Another martech consolidation that forces a choice: go all-in on one stack or pay to stay independent.

stories.title: Stagwell buys Freestar, putting publisher ad sales inside a holdco
stories.take: Buying and selling under one roof again — efficiency for Stagwell, conflict questions for publishers.

stories.title: What McDonald's dropping its FIFA sponsorship means for sports marketing
stories.take: A decades-long World Cup tie-up ending signals how cautiously big brands now price global sports risk.

stories.title: Etsy's crackdown on AI slop is welcome, but it shows how far things have slipped
stories.take: Etsy policing AI listings is good for real makers — and an admission the marketplace let volume win for too long.

stories.title: In Graphic Detail: What Apple's identity block means for the ad money
stories.take: Apple tightening identity again moves money toward logged-in, first-party media — plan budgets accordingly.

stories.title: Thunder star Jalen Williams could miss remainder of season after breaking leg, dislocating ankle
stories.take: A season-altering loss for OKC — Williams and Cason Wallace both need surgery and the title defense just got thin.

stories.title: Jaylen Brown's rep says reported trade request from Celtics is '10,000% a lie'
stories.take: Brown's camp flatly denies he demanded out of Boston before landing with the Sixers — believe the denial, watch the play.

stories.title: Lendeborg 'absolutely' surprising himself as 31-12 night leads Warriors' 1st win
stories.take: 31 and 12 to beat Denver for Golden State's first win — Lendeborg just announced himself.

stories.title: Struggling Bam says critics 'make me the scapegoat' for Heat's 0-4 start
stories.take: Miami is 0-4 and its captain feels singled out — an early-season locker room to watch.

stories.title: More than a championship hangover: Four reasons behind Knicks' troubling 0-3 start
stories.take: New York's 0-3 start has structural causes, not just a hangover — tonight vs. Detroit is an early gut check.

stories.title: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale -- and the uncertainty that still looms
stories.take: How the Lakers changed hands in three days, and why the Luka-era ownership questions are not settled.

stories.title: One win away: Brewers ride 8-run fifth to Game 3 rout, 3-0 World Series lead
stories.take: Milwaukee is one win from its first World Series title after an 8-run fifth buried Tampa Bay in Game 3.

stories.title: How the Rays were broken by the merciless Brewers, who are on the verge of a World Series sweep
stories.take: Game 4 tonight is elimination baseball — the Rays need a pulse at home or this ends in a sweep.

stories.title: 'He likes the moment': Jackson Chourio was made for October
stories.take: Chourio has become the face of this Brewers run — the star turn is happening in real time.

stories.title: Mets' Lindor wins Roberto Clemente Award in 'full-circle moment'
stories.take: Baseball's top humanitarian honor goes to Lindor — a fitting capstone for the Mets captain.

stories.title: Manfred: Small-market World Series good for game, but cap still needed
stories.take: Manfred praises a Brewers-Rays Series while still pushing a salary cap — that fight defines the next CBA.

stories.title: What our final poll before Election Day says about midterms and Trump
stories.take: Final PBS polling favors Democrats as Trump disapproval drives early turnout — one week out, the environment is clear, the margins are not.

stories.title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
stories.take: NPR's poll gives Democrats the edge but flags soft enthusiasm among young, independent and non-white voters.

stories.title: Trump and Rubio head to Texas to stump for Ken Paxton as midterms campaign enters final week
stories.take: Trump puts his closing-week capital behind Paxton in Texas — a test of how far his endorsement still travels.

stories.title: Trump administration charges former FBI Director James Comey for the third time
stories.take: A third charge against Comey a week before the midterms keeps the DOJ's independence fight front and center.

stories.title: How congressional Democrats are preparing for claims of election fraud by Trump
stories.take: Democrats are pre-writing legal filings and coordinating with local officials before any fraud claim lands.

stories.title: Israelis are voting on whether to oust Netanyahu in first election since Oct. 7 attack
stories.take: High turnout in Israel's most consequential vote in years — a winner may not be known for weeks as coalitions form.

stories.title: Lula prevails in Brazil but Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede
stories.take: Brazil's result is in, the concession is not — another election where the aftermath is the story.

stories.title: Student-led movement ousts Serbia's right-wing ruler in historic election
stories.take: Students toppled an entrenched ruler in Serbia — the protest-to-ballot pipeline worked there.

stories.title: FBI raids billionaire's Beverly Hills mansion in connection with Eric Swalwell probe, sources say
stories.take: A Beverly Hills raid tied to the Swalwell probe is today's biggest California political story — details are still sourced and thin.

stories.title: El Niño's record-hot ocean waters driving coastal flooding in Southern California
stories.take: Record tides are flooding Newport, Huntington and Long Beach — a preview of what El Niño does to this coast all season.

stories.title: Californians revolt against police drones after rapid adoption across state
stories.take: Drones spread faster than the rules around them; cities statewide are now writing the limits after the fact.

stories.title: Despite lame duck status, Newsom could take a final shot at utilities' liability for wildfires
stories.take: Wildfire liability is the unfinished fight of Newsom's tenure — his last shot at it shapes rates and risk for years.

stories.title: 9th Circuit denies feds' appeal over 20,000 ballots; district court hearing to proceed
stories.take: The DOJ push to segregate 20,000 California ballots stalls in court, with a district hearing next — certification timing is the stakes.

stories.title: L.A. homicides are down to near-historic lows — but killings of Black men persist
stories.take: The headline trend is real progress; the disparity inside it is the part city leaders still have not solved.

stories.title: Get up to speed fast on the California election with our guide for the still undecided
stories.take: Still undecided a week out? This is the fastest honest catch-up on the California ballot.

stories.title: Nate Silver Predicts a ‘Momentous’ Midterm
stories.take: Senate: Democrats 70%+ to flip it, needing four Republican seats • House: Democrats 90%+ in Silver's model, about +22 seats on average — not a 40-60 wave • Bottom line: if polls hold, Silver calls it momentous — Trump becomes a 'super lame duck' and 2028 starts election night • Driver is an ~11-point midterm backlash, with Maine and Michigan the flip's risk points

stories.title: Israel holds first election since October 7th attacks
stories.take: Voters weigh accountability for Oct. 7 security failures, corruption and religious influence • Netanyahu, 77, has avoided taking responsibility for that day's failings • Also: Brazil's result, Anthropic's flotation, and dictionary.com's word of the year, 'maxing'

stories.title: Marvel’s Blade Dev Gets Stay of Execution - Kinda Funny Games Daily 10.01.26
stories.take: Arkane Lyon gets a one-month reprieve to find a buyer/partner for Marvel's Blade instead of shutting down • Microsoft also offered voluntary exits to ~60,000 staff, about a quarter of the company • Hosts argue Blade looks close and Xbox should finish it, not dump it for cost reasons

stories.title: We Polled 1,417 Americans About Sports, Politics and Everything in Between
stories.take: Poll of 1,417 adults (±3.6): 62% oppose trans student athletes on teams matching identity vs 23% support • Only 7% say legal gambling helped sports vs 44% negative; 51% think athletes sometimes alter play for gamblers • Strong role model No. 1 is Barack Obama at 59%; Trump 37% strong / 55% not • 2028 test: Mark Cuban (D) beats J.D. Vance 39-34; Vance also loses to Newsom, AOC and Buttigieg

stories.title: Dexter Story’s tribute to the spiritual practice of fasting
stories.take: Bass vs Raman: street homelessness down ~15-20% but only 6,500 of 45,000 housed — incremental, not dramatic • Crime is Bass's stronger record; Raman's 50% homelessness cut by 2028 gets a grain-of-salt warning • DOJ wants ~20,000 CA ballots segregated; a skeptical 9th Circuit panel heard the federalism flaw — no federal law directs that segregation

stories.title: The $800 Billion Catch Behind Anthropic's IPO
stories.take: The catch is ~$800B in non-cancelable compute commitments off the income statement — Broadcom $161B, Google $115B • Revenue $16.3B in H1 vs $1.2B a year ago; operating loss narrowed to $693M from $2.1B • S-1 omits customer breakdown and training costs; hosts float ~$1.5T valuation vs $2T talk, with yields rising and tech cracking

stories.title: They Protested ICE. Now They’ve Been Convicted of Terrorism.
stories.take: July 4, 2025 protest outside Prairie Land Detention Center near Dallas ended with a police lieutenant shot in the shoulder — the shooting facts are undisputed • The group included an SRA leader, artists and immigration advocates • NYT reporting uses newly uncovered documents to trace how a protest case became a terrorism conviction

stories.title: Why Meta is giving you Muse for free
stories.take: Answer: free Muse buys Meta 10M+ users and 100M weekly tokens of data to fuel ads, e-commerce referrals and future subscriptions • It was built on standard models, not a breakthrough — the race is shifting to usable products • Caution: a Muse Mac bug was found and fixed with no bounty paid; share only non-sensitive info and keep bank details out for now

stories.title: Another day of record tides, Caruso votes for Bass, Ninth Circuit rejects DOJ on CA voter rolls— Morning Edition
stories.take: Record tides flooded Newport, Huntington and Long Beach, up to three feet in places • Rick Caruso says he will vote for former rival Karen Bass, citing her growth and fire rebuilding • 9th Circuit denied DOJ's emergency bid on ~20,000 CA ballots for lack of jurisdiction; LADWP bills and audits also in focus

stories.title: Democrats Lead In NPR Poll, Preparations For Election Challenge, Israel Voting Begins
stories.take: NPR poll: Democrats +8 on the generic ballot; Trump approval 40% among likely voters • Senate is genuinely uncertain — five toss-ups sit in states Trump won by double digits; Democrats need four net gains • Democrats are prepping legal filings as Trump alleges fraud, offers a $1M tip bounty and floats troops at polls • Israel votes with turnout expected over 70%

stories.title: The Chip Giant Helping Anthropic Buy More Chips
stories.take: Answer: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan lobbied banks and lent Broadcom's credit as guarantor to land Anthropic a $63B debt deal — the largest AI infrastructure deal ever • It is circular financing: suppliers propping up buyers who cannot scale alone, with Blackstone taking the unguaranteed slice • Anthropic's IPO becomes the bellwether for whether that AI trade holds
